artifact_contract.normalization: remove exactly the leading sha256: prefix after validating the raw field; retain and bind both raw and canonical values
artifact_contract.raw_digest_binding: pre-record transport retains artifact.digest exactly as raw_api_digest and stores artifact_digest only after validating and removing one sha256: prefix; signed/provider records bind both values
artifact_contract.status: contract specified; live artifact response absent
artifact_contract.upload_step_provenance: workflow source at immutable workflow commit supplies step id/name; jobs API supplies step name/status/conclusion/number only; no REST step.id is assumed

upload_step_source_mapping.join_rule: source id/name and immutable workflow commit are matched to the exact run-attempt job; a REST step.id or generated fixture string cannot substitute

authority_graph.adoption_removal_rule: temporary authority removal requires signed/read-back adoption record, durable trust-root verification, exact ref/tree/schema mapping, and API readback of removal

consumer_census.coverage_rule: exactly one terminal successful row for every required workflow/job/check identity at resulting main SHA and run attempt; exclusions are separately recorded
consumer_census.self_exclusion_rule: verify-B own workflow/job/check is excluded by exact repository, workflow path, job_key, check_name, and external_id; no name-only exclusion

authority_graph.old_policy_context: removed only after Main-B proof and Tree-B Policy success

MainB.policy_context_owner: provider-backed Policy-bootstrap-B check plus ci-main caller

TreeA.consumer_closure: all current required PR/unit/preview/release consumers must be terminal success

TreeB.consumer_closure: same full required consumer set; temporary authorities removed only after readback
TreeB.policy_context_owner: permanent Policy verifier after exact Main-B readback

before_signature: derive provider_result_id and nonce once from the exact pre-record artifact and resulting main SHA
create the Policy-bootstrap-B Check with external_id=provider_result_id, head_sha=resulting_main_sha, name=Policy-bootstrap-B
read back the created check id and app.id; reject any mismatch before signing
check_allocation.terminalization: after the signed result and outer digest are stored, update the same immutable check identity to completed/success; verify-B reads the exact run/check response and rejects replacement or replay

credential.transport: provider-owned credential only; never GITHUB_TOKEN and never injected into build/attest jobs

signature.anti_replay_binding: signed provider result binds repository, source artifact ID/raw/canonical digests, provider_result_id, check external_id, resulting_main_sha, verifier revision, and a provider nonce; the URL is read back and must equal provider_result_id
signature.signed_bytes: canonical provider-result payload including provider_result_id, source artifact id/digests, resulting main SHA, check name/external_id/head/status/conclusion/app id, and nonce; provider_result_digest is the outer response digest only

transport.check_readback: GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/check-runs/{check_run_id}; retain and require name, external_id, head_sha, app.id, status, conclusion, and id; no integration_id is read from the Check Runs API
transport.check_write: provider App Checks API create/update with name=Policy-bootstrap-B, head_sha=resulting_main_sha, external_id=provider_result_id
transport.pre_record_download: GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/artifacts/{pre_record_artifact_id}/zip; verify raw SHA-256 and size
transport.result_readback: GET {provider_result_endpoint}/v2/results/{provider_result_id}; verify exact signed bytes and digest
transport.status: protocol concrete; provider identities and live implementation unresolved

repair_contract.isolated_reproduction: build_repair_checkpoint.py runs in a fresh TemporaryDirectory with only this model and emitted fixtures
repair_contract.provider_digest_rule: provider_result_digest is SHA-256 over exactly S7b_provider_result.ordered_field_ids; excluded/provider-owned fields never enter the digest
repair_contract.provider_output_rule: No field whose producer is external-provider-result may be absent from canonical_schemas.provider_result; verification/verifier leaves are produced by verify-B.
repair_contract.temporal_lint_rule: reject any pre-record field produced at or after S7a; reject release asset/final-manifest values whose producer stage is later than their declared stage

sole_input_rule: This JSON is the sole contract/schema/field/preimage input. No historical schema, vocabulary, or bundle file is read.

S0_caller_readback.source: workflow_call selectors plus Actions run and Contents API readback

S1_build.source: unprivileged build output and upload-artifact response

S2_artifact_verify.source: Actions REST run/job/artifact API and raw service ZIP bytes

S3_release_reserve.source: draft release API response with nonzero ID

S4_binding_attest.source: canonical binding predicate bytes and attestation API response

S5_publish.source: immutable release asset upload and raw REST readback

S6_release_attest.source: release predicate bytes, OIDC certificate and automatic release attestation API

S7a_pre_record_transport.source: strict pre-record bytes plus Actions artifact REST response

S7b_provider_result.source: provider-owned verifier, signed result bytes, Checks API and raw artifact/API readback

S7c_verify_b.source: provider result readback, called-workflow OIDC/API readback, and post-provider terminal census

TreeB_adoption.source: reviewed adoption PR input plus live Main-B provider/release/census readback
